records.provenance: Every source record's provenance is the AUIF lineage (integration, source system, source record id, translation pack id, version and hash, canonical id, observation, observed and effective time, validation state, manifest, schema fingerprint, provenance chain, batch) instead of the M3 file provenance (file hash, file name, row in file). The APG fields M3 also records (template_id, mapping_version, ingest_version, received_at, uploaded_by, uploader_kind, source, file_name, row_no) are present on both paths with the same meaning; file_sha256 exists only on the M3 path. Compared: everything else in the payload, byte for byte.
records.ingest_receipt: Keyed 'auif:<delivery digest>:<mapping>:<source>' instead of '<file hash>:<mapping>:<source>'; file_sha256 and size are null (AUIF never hands APG the file); an 'auif' block names the integration, batch, pack, manifest and delivery digest. Compared: status, entity, template_id, mapping_version, ingest_version, source, file_name, received_at, uploaded_by, counts, blank_rows, unmapped_columns, stripped_scope_columns, results.
records.evidence_keys: ingest_reject, ingest_duplicate and ingest_stale entries are keyed '<batch>:<row>' instead of '<file hash>:<row>'; their content is compared apart from provenance.
records.audit_log: The AUIF path writes its own audit events (auif.*, ingest.auif_batch_applied) in place of ingest.file_ingested. Audit chains are compared for validity only.

corpus.about: The M3 fault corpus (apg/ingest/corpus.py, 44 cases on the AP-invoice layout) sent through AUIF's own file importer. 'same' = the same stored records, row results and assessment status as M3. 'refused' = nothing is stored and the assessment cannot proceed (M3 refuses the whole file in these cases too, or the AUIF path is stricter). 'differs' = a stated difference.

refused_on_both_paths.F01: empty file: AUIF's importer cannot read a header, so discovery fails and the integration never becomes ACTIVE (M3: EMPTY_FILE)
refused_on_both_paths.F02: NUL byte: AUIF's importer refuses the file (M3: NUL_BYTE)
refused_on_both_paths.F03: not UTF-8: AUIF's importer refuses the file (M3: ENCODING)
refused_on_both_paths.F04: a mapped column missing: the schema fingerprint no longer matches the pack, the integration is not ACTIVE (M3: MISSING_COLUMNS)
refused_on_both_paths.F05: a repeated column name: AUIF's importer refuses the header (M3: DUPLICATE_HEADER)
refused_on_both_paths.F06: an unclosed quote: AUIF's importer refuses the file (M3: MALFORMED_CSV)
refused_on_both_paths.F07: over the size limit: the APG mapping rules refuse it (FILE_TOO_LARGE). On the AUIF path the limit is measured on the delivered rows written back in the template layout, not on the source file's bytes (M3: FILE_TOO_LARGE)
refused_on_both_paths.F08: over the row limit: the APG mapping rules refuse it (TOO_MANY_ROWS) (M3: TOO_MANY_ROWS)
refused_on_both_paths.F10: semicolon-separated: one column, schema fingerprint mismatch (M3: MISSING_COLUMNS)
refused_on_both_paths.T02: an extra 'Tenant ID' column: schema fingerprint mismatch (M3: refused as a foreign tenant claim)
refused_on_both_paths.T03: a cell holding JSON text that names another tenant: the APG tenant screen refuses the delivery; nothing stored (M3: refused as a foreign tenant claim)
refused_on_both_paths.T04: an extra 'org_id' column: schema fingerprint mismatch (M3: refused as a foreign tenant claim)
refused_on_both_paths.T05: an extra tenant column: schema fingerprint mismatch (M3: refused as a foreign tenant claim)

F09.m3: file_rejected MISSING_COLUMNS (the byte-order mark becomes part of the first column name)
F09.auif: AUIF's importer decodes utf-8-sig, so the byte-order mark is dropped and the file is read normally: same records as the good file; the assessment can proceed
F09.why: A byte-order mark is an encoding marker, not data: nothing is lost and nothing is guessed. AUIF is more lenient than M3 here.

F11.m3: a valid empty delivery: the receipt is recorded with 0 rows, nothing is stored, and the receipt does not stop the assessment
F11.auif: refused: AUIF reports NO_DATA and the adapter refuses the import with SOURCE_EMPTY (M8-R1, finding M8-F7); nothing stored, cannot assess
F11.why: AUIF path stricter, as the independent audit of APG-M8 requires: an empty source cannot stand for current data. M3 itself is not changed (outside M8-R1).

H10.m3: row stored; the blank lines are skipped and counted
H10.auif: refused: AUIF's importer treats an empty line as a row that does not match the header; nothing stored, cannot assess
H10.why: AUIF is stricter. A truly blank line has no data, so nothing is lost by refusing, but the file cannot be used until it is cleaned.

R01.auif: refused: AUIF's importer refuses the whole page when a row does not match the header; nothing stored, cannot assess

R03.auif: refused: the blank value is AUIF's source identity (the invoice_id column); on AUIF rev14 that record is refused (IDENTITY_MISSING) and the batch is refused whole; nothing stored, cannot assess. (APG-M8 to M8-R2, on rev13: AUIF's observation contract refused the empty object_id and sync raised, finding M8-F6.)

R13.auif: refused: AUIF's input guard refuses a page holding a control character; nothing stored, cannot assess

T01.m3: an extra 'tenant_id' column naming the SAME tenant is stripped and the row stored
T01.auif: refused: the extra column changes the schema fingerprint; the integration is not ACTIVE; cannot assess
T01.why: Any column change is schema drift for AUIF. AUIF is stricter.

source_empty.about: M8-R1: Builder Zero tenant zero_two has header-only files. M3 records each as a valid empty delivery and can assess. The AUIF path refuses each one with SOURCE_EMPTY (no approved contract says an empty delivery of any record type is valid), so zero_two CANNOT be assessed through AUIF, while its stored records, figures and detection results are the same as on the M3 path. tests_m8/test_m8_path_equivalence.py checks exactly these scopes.
